answer_2.quote: Reliability assesses how accurate the edit is performed [...] Generality evaluates the model's capacity to apply the edit correctly [...] Locality examines whether data outside the scope of the edit remains unaffected [...] Portability evaluates the robustness of the generalization of the edit [...] Correct Answer Probability (CAP) measures the probability that the model generates the correct answer [...] Direct Probability (DP) assesses the model's likelihood of producing the edited knowledge [...] Editing Overfit Score (EOS) evaluates whether the model overfits [...] Answer Modify Score (AMS) measures unintended interference [...]
